name: Chaosflix
description: Browse and stream Chaos Computer Club conference talks from media.ccc.de directly in Jellyfin. Includes watch history, resume, SyncPlay support, popular/recommended talks, year-based browsing, and related talk suggestions.

versions.changelog:
Breaking changes:
- requires Jellyfin 12.1.0 or newer (raised from 10.11.0)
Bug fixes:
- report a raised minimum server version as breaking (#113)
- stop Popular and Recommended reshuffling on every refresh (#111)
- stop inventing a community rating from the view count (#108)
- judge a conflicted rebase by the branch being rebased (#106)
- and 3 more
Plus 3 other changes.

Features:
- show the plugin's state on its configuration page (#93)
Plus 5 other changes.
